DABS.verified: Product detail page (webapps2.abc.utah.gov ProductLocatorCore, GetDetailUrl → ProductDetail/Index) embeds an inline 350 px-tall PNG, alt 'Product bottle or can'. 38/100 sample CSCs have one; identical files are attached to several sizes of some brands (Five Wives, Porter's Fire). Catalog JSON, monthly XLSX, drawing and allocated pages carry no image.
DABS.source_of_images: DABS New Item Listings page: listing applications include 'High-resolution product image' and 'Images of unit and case UPCs' (https://abs.utah.gov/vendors/new-item-listings/). Only a 350 px copy and no UPC are public.
DABS.rights: Utah.gov disclaimer: 'The State makes no warranty, however, that the materials contained within these pages are free from copyright claims, or other restrictions or limitations on free use or display.' (https://www.utah.gov/support/disclaimer.html)
DABS.UT DABS app (claim): App Store text lists search by category, name, price, bottle size, ratings, availability; it does not mention photos. Not installed or observed.

Utah Neat (utahneat.app).verified: Public, robots-allowed /api/products returns an image_url field. 175 of 783 unique products have one, all hotlinked from thewhiskyedition.com (a review site); 62 distinct image URLs; 147 products share an image URL with at least one other product (other sizes, ages or expressions).

Liquor In Front (liquorinfront.com).verified: Public web-app script requests `/api/products/{sku}/image` from api.liquorinfront.com and shows it when a product has hasImage; its stylesheet comment says 'White well like every thumbnail (the DABS photos carry a baked-in white ground)'. So its thumbnails are DABS photos keyed by SKU and inherit DABS's reuse and staleness.
Liquor In Front (liquorinfront.com).not verified: Rendered pages or image rights; no robots.txt served (returns the app HTML).
